task: Study what genuine creators changed or selected, not automate decoration or infer taste from SVG pixels.

Allow horizontal/vertical brand lockups after the glyph system, not call lockup rearrangement new strokes.

classification_policy.stage_1: Aesthetic prior must be creator-published source material with actual author/client production or explicit before/after. Don't blindly elevate blog paraphrases.
classification_policy.stage_2: For any candidate wordmark, prove real Hanzi reading and canonical component/stroke source first, with real Chinese reader approval for final acceptance.
classification_policy.stage_3: Before vs after must differ in a substantive, phrase-specific identity decision, NOT solely change font family, crop, typography scale, x-stretch or vector node count.
classification_policy.stage_4: An approved professional case is observational learning data, not an independent panel-reviewed quantified gain.
classification_policy.stage_5: A source example is TRAINING; no leave-one-out evaluation on a source previously inspected. Any future blind prediction must use truly held-out creator case with revealed final only after freezing prediction.
classification_policy.stage_6: Prevent false success: minimum one valid independent review with stated text legibility and preferred concept + another dissimilar frozen wordmark repeat before model rule VALIDATED_RULE=true.

asset_policy: Record public URLs/captions and observations only, do not rehost or send third-party image binaries or proprietary font glyphs.
